Artifacts.Name: Module Topics
Artifacts.Description: Outlines the full scope of the module's content—covering responsive web design fundamentals, fluid grids, flexible images, media queries, mobile-first development, and related frameworks—serving as a navigational overview for learners and instructors to understand what topics will be taught and in what sequence.

Artifacts.Name: Module Topics (HTML)
Artifacts.Description: This page outlines the topics covered in Module 11, focusing on responsive web design concepts such as fluid layouts, flexible images, and media queries that enable websites to adapt across multiple screen sizes, serving as a navigational overview for learners to preview and access the module's subject areas.

Artifacts.Name: Introduction to Responsive Web Design
Artifacts.Description: A reading that introduces responsive web design by explaining what it is, why it matters in a multi-device world, and how it enables websites to adapt across smartphones, tablets, and desktops, giving learners the conceptual foundation for the module.

Artifacts.Name: Fluid Grids and Flexible Layouts
Artifacts.Description: A reading that explains how fluid grids and flexible layouts work using proportional units instead of fixed pixels, enabling page elements to resize proportionally across screen sizes, which learners study to understand the structural basis of responsive design.

Artifacts.Name: Flexible Images and Media
Artifacts.Description: A reading that covers techniques for making images, videos, and embedded media scale gracefully across different screen sizes, addressing common layout-breaking problems caused by fixed-dimension media, which learners use to apply responsive media practices.

Artifacts.Name: CSS Media Queries
Artifacts.Description: A reading that explains CSS media queries — how they apply conditional style rules based on device characteristics such as screen width — so learners can write breakpoint-driven CSS that adapts layouts to different devices.

Artifacts.Name: Mobile-First Design Philosophy
Artifacts.Description: A reading that describes the mobile-first design philosophy, explaining why designers begin with small-screen constraints and progressively enhance for larger screens, helping learners understand this workflow and its performance and usability benefits.

Artifacts.Name: Viewport Configuration and Screen Sizes
Artifacts.Description: A reading that explains how the viewport meta tag controls how mobile browsers render and scale web pages, covering viewport configuration options and common screen size considerations so learners can prevent default desktop-scaling behavior on mobile devices.
